{{Quote|This wreck is a large capital cruiser that easily dates back to the Old Republic.|[[Foreman/Legends|Foreman]] [[Chivos]]|<ref name="SWG:SoD">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Salvage or Die|Mustafar}}</ref>}}
A '''''Hammerhead''-class cruiser''' was in service during the times of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. Its wreck was found thousands of years later on the planet [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]].

==History==
{{Quote|Today we located a crashed vessel of that appears to be Old Republic in origin. All the ships systems seem to be off line but functional which have our engineers baffled as to the cause of the crash. The only occupant that we were able to find of the ship was a droid of unknown design. Surprisingly, after all this time, the droid seems to be in excellent condition and our engineers are confident that they will be able to reactivate it. Maybe it will have some clues about the origin of the vessel.|A [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|separatist]]|<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />}}
At an unknown point in time during or after the [[Galactic War]],<ref name="TOR1">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The Foundry}}</ref><ref name="TOR2">{{TORcite|type=flashpoint|The False Emperor}}</ref><ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">HK-47 appears in the videogame ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', placing the crash during or after the events of the game</ref> during the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] era, the cruiser crashed on the volcanic world of [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. Due to the heavy volcanic activity and evershifting landmasses, the wreck was buried underneath layers of lava, rock and ash.<ref name="SWG:TDS">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Downed Ship|Mustafar}}</ref>

[[File:Hammerhead_Mustafar.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The wrecked ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser during the Galactic Civil War.]]
Thousands of years later, a huge earthquake brought the remains of the cruiser back to light.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> It was the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the planet was under the control of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. When the wreck was discovered, [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]] separatists immediately closely examined it.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> They were very protective of the crash site and did not allow any [[Mustafarian/Legends|Mustafarian]] the chance to examine the wreckage.<ref name="SWG:ORC" /> No records of the crash were found aboard the ship and no [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] who had examined it could explain why it crashed. Inside the wreckage, the Neimoidians found the deactivated body of an very old [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droid]]. When they reactivated the droid, it went on a rampage, killing several Neimoidians and the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] that were supposed to protect them. The droid turned out to be none other than [[HK-47]],<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> a rogue assassin droid that had once served [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Meetra Surik]] thousands of years earlier.<ref name="KotOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref><ref name="KotOR2">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''</ref> The Separatist experts were amazed by the technology used in this droid, but were unable to perform a memory wipe due to its incomprehensible thought matrix. As a solution, the engineers transferred HK-47's memory and thought patterns into a functioning sub-system of the crashed cruiser and took the empty chassis with them. While the Separatist scientists studied HK-47's body in their new [[Neimoidian droid factory|droid factory]], the droid's AI managed to meld with the ship and took over its operational systems, forcing the scientists to seal up the ship and disconnect its uplink.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> The cruiser was left abandoned, leaving valuable salvage behind.<ref name="SWG:ORC" />

[[File:Hammerhead_Mustafar_cockpit.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The cockpit of the cruiser where the spacers found HK-47.]]
At the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], a gang of [[Salvage bandits]] had moved onto the site to claim any valuable piece of technology for their own. They were very intent upon keeping everyone else away from their prize.<ref name="SWG:ORC" /> Twenty years after the defeat of the Separatists,<ref name="SWG:TTwH" /> in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] working for [[Mensix Corp]] explored the wreckage of the ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser to salvage power rods<ref name="SWG:SoD" /> and to search for valuable technology. HK-47 thus used the systems of the ship to contact and trick the spacers.<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> HK-47 instructed the spacers to aid in transferring his artificial intelligence from the ship to an [[Old Research Facility|abandoned research facility]] nearby,<ref name="SWG:TTotA">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|The Transfer of the AI|Mustafar}}</ref> and then to an old [[Neimoidian droid factory|Separatist droid factory]] on Mustafar.<ref name="SWG:WPWT">{{SWGcite|exp=ToOW|type=general|Wrong Place, Wrong Time|Mustafar}}</ref> This eventually allowed HK-47 to be reunited with his body and to begin the production of a large [[HK-47's Droid Army|droid army]].<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />

==Behind the scenes==
The wreckage of this ''Hammerhead''-class cruiser appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CSE" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The wreckage of ''Hammerhead'' cruiser was added to the game with the release of the expansion pack [[Star Wars Galaxies: Trials of Obi-Wan|''Trials of Obi-Wan'']] on [[November 1]], [[2005]]. The ship could be found on the central island near the [[Central volcano/Legends|Central volcano]] and was surrounded by many Salvage bandits.<ref name="SWG:CSE" /> It was part of a quest surrounding the assassin droid HK-47. During this quest, the player entered the ship and accessed the ship's computers to talk to HK-47<ref name="SWG:TDS" /> and transfer him to the droid factory<ref name="SWG:WPWT" /> where he was eventually reunited with his body.<ref name="SWG:TTwH" />
